title: ui-demo-preview product story
intent: Show skill authors turning one rough UI-demo idea into an approved, recordable five-scene plan.

scenes.title: Start with one rough idea
scenes.goal: Make the requested workflow and audience concrete.
scenes.action: Choose Inventory Ops and review the five planned beats.
scenes.subtitle: Start with the story, not the recorder

scenes.title: Generate five SVG scenes
scenes.goal: Create a cheap visual plan before screenshots or video.
scenes.action: Click Build five scenes and watch the activity log complete.
scenes.subtitle: Turn intent into five editable SVG mockups

scenes.title: Switch between scene states
scenes.goal: Compare the story without scrubbing a rendered video.
scenes.action: Select scene 3 and inspect its action, subtitle, and cursor target.
scenes.subtitle: Click any scene to compare the flow

scenes.title: Mark one scene for revision
scenes.goal: Capture actionable feedback while changes are still cheap.
scenes.action: Choose Revise and enter a note about the cursor target.
scenes.subtitle: Keep, revise, or cut each scene

scenes.title: Export an approved recording plan
scenes.goal: End with visible proof that production can begin.
scenes.action: Export feedback and reveal the Recording unlocked state.
scenes.subtitle: Record only after the storyboard is approved
